title: A Robot in the Kitchen
lines: Last year, a small restaurant in Chiang Mai bought a robot called Rice.
It cannot cook, but **it** can carry plates from the kitchen to the tables.
The owner, Mr. Ton, says the robot was expensive, but it saves time.
Before Rice came, his two waiters walked about fifteen kilometers a day.
Now **they** have more time to talk to customers and take orders.
Children love the robot. **Some** come to the restaurant just to see it.
Rice has a small screen with a smiling face, and it says "Enjoy your
meal!" in Thai, English and Chinese. Not everyone is happy, though. An
older customer told a reporter that she preferred a real person. "A
robot cannot understand when I want less sugar," she said. Mr. Ton
agrees that **this** is a problem. He says he will never replace his
waiters. "The robot helps them. It does not take their jobs," he says.
